entities.name: PMID:25423276
observations: In 11 selected acromegaly patients with incomplete resection, 3D MRI volume and plasma GH measurements showed a high correlation between percent tumor resection and percent GH reduction (p=0.006); abstract does not report correlation coefficient.

entities.name: Percent resection-GH correlation
observations: A selected 11-patient acromegaly surgical cohort showed a reported high correlation between percent tumor resection and percent plasma GH reduction (p=0.006); effect size is unavailable in the abstract.
